description: Header file defining thread-safe, low-level raw logging routines for the Abseil library, including macros for logging and checking conditions, and internal functions for signal-safe logging.

classes.name: absl::raw_log_internal::LogFilterAndPrefixHook
classes.description: Function pointer type for customizing log message filtering and prefixing.

classes.name: absl::raw_log_internal::AbortHook
classes.description: Function pointer type for aborting the process on fatal logs.

classes.name: absl::raw_log_internal::InternalLogFunction
classes.description: Function pointer type for internal logging dispatch.

methods.name: absl::raw_log_internal::Basename
methods.description: Compile-time function to extract the base filename from a path.

methods.name: absl::raw_log_internal::RawLog
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at a given severity level, without memory allocation or locking.

methods.name: absl::raw_log_internal::AsyncSignalSafeWriteToStderr
methods.description: Writes a buffer directly to stderr in a signal-safe manner.

methods.name: absl::raw_log_internal::RawLoggingFullySupported
methods.description: Checks if raw logging is fully supported on the current platform.

methods.name: absl::raw_log_internal::RegisterLogFilterAndPrefixHook
methods.description: Registers a hook for customizing log filtering and message prefixing.

methods.name: absl::raw_log_internal::RegisterAbortHook
methods.description: Registers a hook to abort the process on fatal logs.

methods.name: absl::raw_log_internal::RegisterInternalLogFunction
methods.description: Registers a custom internal log dispatch function.
